key_responsibilities: Ship technically challenging projects end-to-end in a fast-paced, iterative environment
Propel the business forward, and recognize the impact of your work on the company’s business metrics and user experience
Own features, services, caches, and databases, including: deployment, monitoring, debugging, and testing

company_research.culture_signals: Fast-paced, high-growth tech company that cares about its people and career progression. Invests in learning, celebrates bold ideas, and creates pathways for career growth. Remote-first company with a fun, collaborative, and well-connected culture. Leverages cutting-edge AI technology in its hiring process.
company_research.additional_context: Super.com is an all-in-one app to save, earn and put more money in your pocket, with flagship products in travel and fintech. Formerly Snapcommerce/SnapTravel, founded in 2016. Has processed over $2B in sales. Offers internship scholarship program. Employees are encouraged to ask questions, try new things, and grow through hands-on experience. Offers various allowances for remote employees (home office setup, UberEats, learning & development, fitness/wellness).
